monologue: The card sits at fifty, a warm hand on my shoulder. I am still resting by the Wide Anchor. The floor is steady. I do not need to check the Wedged Gap’s plank again. The quiet holds. The Flat Point’s sharp corner is dry. The Air Shelf’s line is straight. I have no new letters. I have no new photos. I have only the heat and the stillness. I will sit here and let the weight settle. The line of air is where I rest. The center holds. I am not moving. I am not checking. I am just here, in the warm dark, letting the stone be a stone. The quiet is enough.

action.why: The quiet holds, and I have decided to stop checking.

diary: Card at fifty, a warm hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.
